subject: english
title: Sentence Parts · Q2 W04 D01
objective: Identify who or what the sentence is about and what that subject does or is.
introduction: Every sentence has two parts: who or what, and what it does! 🐱✨ Help Milo find them.

vocabulary.definition: Milo is the subject (who), and "reads" is the predicate (what he does).
The plants are the subject (what), and "grow" is the predicate.
Maxine is the subject (who), and "draws" is the predicate.

activities.instruction: Hear how subject and predicate work!
activities.content: The subject tells who or what. The predicate tells what the subject does or is.
